run_fastcsp_full_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config file and default stages
run_fastcsp_custom_stages: run the FastCSP CLI with a config file and custom workflow stages like generate and relax
run_fastcsp_generate_only: run the FastCSP CLI to generate crystal structures using Genarris with a config file
run_fastcsp_evaluate_stage: run the FastCSP CLI with the evaluate stage to compare against experimental structures
run_fastcsp_free_energy: run the FastCSP CLI with the free_energy stage to compute free energy corrections
